stemMd: What had the original proposal forecast?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No evaluation until every tree had matured

options.label: B
options.textMd: A fully shaded square during the first week

options.label: C
options.textMd: No need for watering under any conditions

options.label: D
options.textMd: Substantial shade only after several years

options.label: E
options.textMd: Immediate elimination of all urban heat

explanationMd: The forecast explicitly placed substantial shade several years in the future. Therefore the first-year temperature result must be interpreted against the project’s developmental timeline, not an assumed immediate benefit.

distractorRationale.b: The proposal allowed time for crown growth.
distractorRationale.c: Watering was identified as relevant to development.
distractorRationale.e: The forecast concerned shade from growing trees.
